description: A single detected source column mapped to a target field, as produced by the TmImportWizard mapping step. A null TargetFieldKey means the column is ignored.

members.name: ColumnIndex
members.description: Zero-based index of the source column (matches ImportColumn.Index).

members.name: ColumnName
members.description: Detected name of the source column.

members.name: TargetFieldKey
members.description: Key of the ImportTargetField this column maps to, or null when the column is ignored.
